words.prose: {{ar:يَقُولُ}} ({{tr:yaqūlu}}) opens the ayah by making the human's own speech the evidence. The verb is completed not by a separate noun object but by the quoted clause {{ar:أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُّبَدًا}} ({{tr:ahlaktu mālan lubadan}}), so the boast is grammatically inseparable from the speech frame and arrives without a buffer between report and exposure. Its unnamed third-person subject resumes the already-indicted human from 90:4 and keeps the narrator outside the quote, while the following first-person {{ar:أَهْلَكْتُ}} ({{tr:ahlaktu}}) exposes the ego speaking from inside it. Because the surface is imperfect Form I, the claim feels live or habitual and self-authored; the ayah does not need causative attribution or fabricated-speech morphology to indict him. The common root becomes locally specialized as public self-display, like reported human misreadings elsewhere (89:15-16), and the next ayah turns from what he says to what he reckons (90:7). Even the sound arc moves from the rounded release of {{ar:يَقُولُ}} ({{tr:yaqūlu}}) toward the tighter closure of {{ar:لُّبَدًا}} ({{tr:lubadan}}).

words.prose: {{ar:أَهْلَكْتُ}} ({{tr:ahlaktu}}) is the ego-center of the quote. Its perfect first-person form lets the speaker package the loss as a completed achievement he owns, and its active Form IV valency makes {{ar:مَالًا}} ({{tr:mālan}}) the object he claims to have caused to perish. That is sharper than neutral spending language: the root field turns expenditure into ruin, depletion, and annihilated value, with a peril edge that makes the boast sound self-implicating rather than secure. Resource-consumption senses help explain why this destruction verb can be applied to wealth without replacing the local causative form, while the chosen active Form IV keeps the focus away from intransitive self-ruin, passive ruined wealth, or repeated-destruction morphology and centers agency over loss. The verb enters only inside {{ar:يَقُولُ}} ({{tr:yaqūlu}}), so the destructive act is first a boastful verbal claim. Against divine destruction language such as 6:6, the same root field is miniaturized into a human's self-display over possessions. The next ayah asks whether he thinks no one saw him (90:7), turning this completed claim into accountable conduct, and the hamza-led hard consonants make the entry into the boast sound abrupt.

words.prose: {{ar:مَالًا}} ({{tr:mālan}}) is the thing the speaker claims to have destroyed. Its accusative role makes wealth the patient of {{ar:أَهْلَكْتُ}} ({{tr:ahlaktu}}), while the following {{ar:لُّبَدًا}} ({{tr:lubadan}}) locks onto it as an indefinite descriptor or state, so the object is both unspecified and magnified. The singular noun gathers the asset-field into mass wealth rather than enumerated properties, and the lack of a possessive suffix keeps attention on magnitude and expenditure more than legal ownership. Because the root field names possessed value, goods, property, and assets, the destruction frame inverts wealth's normal value into waste. The object sits between destructive agency and final density, letting the boast move from 'I destroyed' to heaped wealth; inside the speech frame, wealth is recruited into verbal self-display rather than simply named as a possession. Its shared indefinite -an cadence with the descriptor makes object and scale sound like one swollen phrase, with the open wealth term giving way to the denser close. Intertexts sharpen that inversion: wealth that fails to avail in 69:28, wealth gathered and counted in 104:2, and the later feeding of need in 90:14 all make this {{ar:مَالًا}} ({{tr:mālan}}) look like value routed into self-display instead of service.

words.prose: {{ar:لُّبَدًا}} ({{tr:lubadan}}) is the ayah's final thickening word. Locally it agrees with {{ar:مَالًا}} ({{tr:mālan}}) as an indefinite accusative descriptor, while the circumstantial reading also remains possible: the wealth is either heaped in description or destroyed in a heaped state. Its matching indefiniteness does not identify a known pile; it leaves the scale open and swollen inside the boast. In both lines, the word does more than say 'much'; the root field gives abundance tactile pressure, as matted, layered, clinging, crowded mass. Its noun-like surface presents compacted outcome rather than the process of matting, treating heaps as collective bulk instead of counted units, and accepted vocalic or gemination variants preserve that density while changing texture rather than governing the canonical surface. The rare root and the crowding image in 72:19 transfer bodily mass-pressure onto wealth here. Because the word is delayed until closure, the boast lands not on the speaker but on dense accumulation; the shared indefinite cadence of {{ar:مَالًا لُّبَدًا}} ({{tr:mālan lubadan}}) binds object and scale into one swollen phrase before 90:7 answers the massed boast with the question of even one witness. Its doubled-looking onset, possible reduced movement, and clipped b-d close make the final sound enact the compression the word names.

topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses {{ar:لُّبَدًا}} ({{tr:lubadan}}) as a descriptor of {{ar:مَالًا}} ({{tr:mālan}}); CRITICAL preserves the compatible state-reading pressure as well.

topics.reason: Variant readings can be used as apparatus for form and sound pressure, while the aligned canonical local surface remains {{ar:لُّبَدًا}} ({{tr:lubadan}}).

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Boastful speech turns wealth into a matted heap.** Lexical evidence: ق و ل B001 “uttered speech,” B007 “circulating talk,” ه ل ك B001 “ruin/destruction,” م و ل B001 “wealth/property,” ل ب د B002 “gathered abundance piled together,” B001 “material compacted layer over layer.” Structural cue: the utterance is sandwiched between two “أيحسب” questions, so the speech itself is suspect. Assigned role: قول projects status; مال supplies counted property; لبد makes it dense and accumulated. Abductive move: I infer that the claim is a self-advertising report rather than transparent accounting. Reading change: “I destroyed much wealth” reads as a boast about heaped expenditure, with the heap itself morally inert and compacted.

2. **Spending as self-ruin rather than liberation.** Lexical evidence: ه ل ك B002 “self-casting into destruction,” B009 “exhausting effort,” B012 “greedy craving”; ل ب د B003 “staying put/sticking to the ground.” Structural cue: the later pass begins with freeing a neck and feeding in famine, but this verse offers only a claim of loss. Assigned role: هلك marks destructive expenditure; لبد marks wealth that remains clumped around the self. Abductive move: I infer contrast between claimed expenditure and actual release of others. Reading change: the wealth is not yet mercy; it is a pile consumed in self-display or self-destruction.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 90:13–16 changed the valence of “أهلكت مالا”: after seeing the pass’s concrete acts, the boast looked like failed spending, not generous loss. 90:17’s mercy exposed the missing motive.

findings.text: Söylenen söz, yalnız bir harcama haberi değil, harcamayı değer ölçüsü yapan iç tutumun kamuya açık göstergesidir.
Tüketilen servet, kişinin gerçek zorlu yola girmek yerine yanlış bir yönde harcadığı yorucu çaba olarak belirir.
Yığılmış servet, hareket sağlayan bir güç olmaktan çok kişiyi yere bağlayan ve sarp geçit önünde hareketsiz bırakan bir ağırlığa dönüşür.
Harcama, başkasını özgürleştirmediğinde kişinin kendisini tüketen ve serveti kendi çevresinde yapışık tutan bir yıkım biçimi olabilir.

butuncul_okuma_line.raw_line: **90:6.** يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا — “Yığın yığın mal harcadım” sözü, gerçek cömertlikten çok kendini gösteren bir servet anlatısı gibi durur: birincil okuma, kişinin çok mal tükettiğini söylemesidir; şaşırtıcı ikincil okuma, “helâk” ve “lübed”in serveti kurtarıcı bir akış değil, sahibinin etrafında keçeleşmiş, yığılmış ve hatta kendini tüketen bir madde olarak göstermesidir. {ق و ل B001; ق و ل B007; ه ل ك B001; ه ل ك B002; ه ل ك B009; م و ل B001; ل ب د B001; ل ب د B002; ل ب د B003}

inter_ayah_rows.note: Presents wealth and offspring as a ground of misplaced status confidence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Explicitly denies that wealth and offspring secure nearness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Counters depletion anxiety by placing replacement beyond the giver's claim.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly rejects the refusal to feed the needy on theological pretext.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Relativizes accumulated worldly goods against what endures.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Treats material abundance as worldly provision, not ultimate valuation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Continues the demotion of lavish possessions to temporary adornment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Identifies love of wealth as a pressure point in human response.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly contrasts withholding from the required path with divine independence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Defines possession as stewardship and calls for expenditure from it.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Differentiates the timing and weight of expenditure within a struggle.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Recasts giving as a loan whose return defeats the language of loss.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Places wealth rivalry within the fleeting worldly competition.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Links miserliness with urging others toward the same withholding.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Requires a material offering before privileged private speech.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Prevents wealth from circulating only among the already wealthy.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Joins striving with wealth and selves to a directed, gainful effort.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Warns that wealth and children can distract from remembrance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Again makes wealth and children a test, reinforcing the corrective frame.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Calls for expenditure as a good directed toward one's own accountable end.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Gives a capacity-sensitive rule for material outlay.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Links wealth and sons to the social profile of resistant arrogance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The failure to urge feeding exposes the social opposite of the focus's route.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Establishes a recognized due in wealth for the deprived.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Completes that due by naming the requester and the deprived.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly forbids giving as a means of seeking greater return.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Unbounded desire for more extends the accumulated-wealth pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Models feeding the needy despite attachment to the provision itself.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Names failure to honor the orphan as a social misuse of abundance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Names failure to urge feeding the poor as the adjacent moral deficit.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Pairs giving with reverent orientation as the positive expenditure pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Pairs stinginess with self-sufficiency, directly opposing the alternative route.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Treats wealth given for purification rather than social return.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Protects the orphan, reinforcing the later recipient pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Protects the requester, reinforcing the ethic of material response.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Makes intense attachment to wealth an explicit inner diagnosis.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Names rivalry in accumulation as a force of distraction.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Shows that accumulation persists until final encounter interrupts it.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Names repelling the orphan as a concrete contrary social practice.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Names failure to urge feeding the needy as the same contrary practice.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly denies that wealth and acquisition can avert final loss.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Land is organized by routes, heights, habitations, and dangerous spaces that shape movement and staying.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Terrain also reaches graves, mountain hollows, nomadic disorientation, ground-hugging basins, travel gear, and a small attendant boat.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Wilderness, Remoteness, and Disorientation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler or nomad moves through remote waste, circles without direction, and risks destruction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: uninhabited wilderness `ب ل د:B001/m02`; remote village, grave, or cut-off place `ك ف ر:B012/m01`; deadly waste or chasm `ه ل ك:B006/m01`; desert traveler without driver `ق ح م:B006/m01`; circling in bewilderment `ه ل ك:B010/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Outside settled land, movement loses its markers. The undriven desert passage, circling bewilderment, and remote cut-off place form a coherent scene of exposure without orientation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Land is organized by routes, heights, habitations, and dangerous spaces that shape movement and staying.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Terrain also reaches graves, mountain hollows, nomadic disorientation, ground-hugging basins, travel gear, and a small attendant boat.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Ground Contact, Burial, and Staying Put
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Bodies, basins, and residents lower themselves to the earth and remain attached to it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: soil and dust `ت ر ب:B001/m01`; grave within bounded land `ب ل د:B001/m03`; grave sides `ص ب ر:B004/m03`; striking or clinging to ground `ب ل د:B010/m01`; staying and adhering `ل ب د:B003/m01`; camel breast lowered in kneeling `ب ل د:B002/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Grounding ranges from habitation to burial and animal posture, but the operation remains the same: descent ends in sustained contact with earth, while the grave's sides define the final bounded space.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Speech moves from bodily articulation to social circulation, attribution, negotiation, and authoritative formulation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Speech can become a circulating reputation, an appropriated saying, fabricated authorship, political rule, or an inward doctrine never voiced.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Tongue, Lips, and Face-to-Face Speech
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Breath and articulation pass through tongue and lips into spoken address between persons.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: organ of speech `ل س ن:B001/m01`; lips `ش ف ه:B001/m01`; mouth-to-mouth address `ش ف ه:B002/m01`; spoken utterance `ق و ل:B001/m01`; tongue as speech instrument `ق و ل:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 90:9 `لِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ` (ل س ن, ش ف ه); 90:6 `يَقُولُ` (ق و ل)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The channel assembles the speaker's apparatus, the produced utterance, and the interpersonal setting in which speech passes directly from one mouth to another.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Speech moves from bodily articulation to social circulation, attribution, negotiation, and authoritative formulation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Speech can become a circulating reputation, an appropriated saying, fabricated authorship, political rule, or an inward doctrine never voiced.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Eloquence, Verbal Attack, and Silencing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A skilled tongue presses an argument or attack until injury or cutting removes its force.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: eloquence and argumentative fluency `ل س ن:B003/m01`; verbal assault `ل س ن:B002/m01`; prolific speaker `ق و ل:B003/m01`; cutting the tongue-tip `ل س ن:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Speech is treated as an exercised capacity that can dominate a contest. The cut tongue supplies the bodily reversal of that power: articulation is stopped at its instrument.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Speech moves from bodily articulation to social circulation, attribution, negotiation, and authoritative formulation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Speech can become a circulating reputation, an appropriated saying, fabricated authorship, political rule, or an inward doctrine never voiced.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Message Relay and Shared Language
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A message is carried through a language and delivered from one person to another.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: language and verbal message `ل س ن:B006/m01`; relaying a message `ل س ن:B008/m01`; reciprocal counsel `و ص ي:B003/m01`; circulating speech `ق و ل:B007/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Language supplies the code, relay supplies transmission, and reciprocal counsel supplies the social network. Speech becomes a durable relation rather than a single utterance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Speech moves from bodily articulation to social circulation, attribution, negotiation, and authoritative formulation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Speech can become a circulating reputation, an appropriated saying, fabricated authorship, political rule, or an inward doctrine never voiced.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reputation, Praise, and Ostentation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Conduct becomes visible talk, producing either earned praise or performative display.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: good public mention `ش ف ه:B004/m01`; speech circulating among people `ق و ل:B007/m01`; action performed to be seen `ر ء ي:B005/m01`; inherited honor and memorable deeds `ح س ب:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Public standing is produced by a loop between action, visibility, and retelling. Praise records recognized worth, while ostentation tries to manufacture the same outcome by staging the act for observers.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Speech moves from bodily articulation to social circulation, attribution, negotiation, and authoritative formulation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Speech can become a circulating reputation, an appropriated saying, fabricated authorship, political rule, or an inward doctrine never voiced.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fabrication, Attribution, and Appropriated Speech
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Words are invented, falsely assigned, or pulled into a speaker's possession.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fabricated discourse `خ ل ق:B007/m01`; false attribution of words `ق و ل:B005/m01`; appropriating a saying `ق و ل:B006/m01`; generated or coined expression `و ل د:B005/m02`; falling into a valley of falsehood `ه ل ك:B011/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Authorship is the contested object. Fabrication creates what was not said, false attribution assigns it to another, and appropriation draws existing speech into one's own claim; the valley image gives continued falsehood a path into which the speaker falls.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Speech moves from bodily articulation to social circulation, attribution, negotiation, and authoritative formulation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Speech can become a circulating reputation, an appropriated saying, fabricated authorship, political rule, or an inward doctrine never voiced.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Negotiation, Rule, and Formal Position
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Parties exchange statements until a ruling, doctrine, or definition fixes the matter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: negotiation `ق و ل:B009/m01`; imposing a ruling `ق و ل:B010/m01`; doctrinal position `ق و ل:B013/m01`; signification `ق و ل:B014/m01`; formal definition `ق و ل:B016/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Discursive action progresses from bargaining to determination. A position may become a doctrine, a sign may be read as speaking, and a definition closes the exchange by fixing a conceptual boundary.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Language directs attention by selecting a referent, opening a question, locating it in time, or marking the form of address.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The network reaches pronoun supports, vocatives, explanatory particles, alphabetic names, oath-openers, and poetic meter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Letter, Sound, and Poetic Alternation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Speech is analyzed into a named letter, arranged into verse, and governed by alternating metrical positions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: letter-name `هاء` `ه ا ء:B006/m01`; lip-formed letters `ش ف ه:B001/m02`; poetic exchange of praise or satire `ه د ي:B011/m01`; metrical alternation `ر ق ب:B014/m01`; poet-name Labid `ل ب د:B008/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Language becomes an explicit craft: articulation supplies phonetic material, meter regulates alternation, and poetic exchange directs the finished speech toward another person.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Language directs attention by selecting a referent, opening a question, locating it in time, or marking the form of address.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The network reaches pronoun supports, vocatives, explanatory particles, alphabetic names, oath-openers, and poetic meter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Personal and Place Names
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Ordinary lexical forms become proper names that identify a person, poet, mountain, or locality.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Jacob as a personal name `ع ق ب:B014/m01`; poet-name Labid `ل ب د:B008/m01`; Mount Uhud `ء ح د:B006/m01`; localities named Yathrib, Turba, or Turban `ت ر ب:B008/m01`; al-Ja'la as a place name `ج ع ل:B011/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Proper naming fixes reference by attaching a lexical form to one recognized bearer. The same operation identifies individuals, authored speech, a mountain, and inhabited places.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material life moves between accumulation, livelihood, feeding, hunger, and the loss of means.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Provision includes wages, hospitality revenue, food heaps, relentless demand, animal appetite, and the idiom of possessing neither hair nor felt.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Accumulated Wealth and Dense Abundance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Property is acquired and amassed until it appears as a compact pile or crowd.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: acquisition and abundance of wealth `م و ل:B001/m01`; wealth piled densely `ل ب د:B002/m01`; prosperity figured as abundant soil `ت ر ب:B003/m01`; present capital `ع ي ن:B011/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 90:6 `مَالًا لُّبَدًا` (م و ل, ل ب د); 90:16 `مَتْرَبَةٍ` (ت ر ب); 90:8 `عَيْنَيْنِ` (ع ي ن)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Abundance is given both economic and spatial form. Wealth becomes present capital, then accumulates visibly as material laid layer upon layer.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material life moves between accumulation, livelihood, feeding, hunger, and the loss of means.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Provision includes wages, hospitality revenue, food heaps, relentless demand, animal appetite, and the idiom of possessing neither hair nor felt.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Appetite, Food Heap, and Competition
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Food is amassed, approached by appetite, and contested by those pressing toward it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: eating and tasting `ط ع م:B001/m01`; piled provisions `ص ب ر:B011/m02`; ravenous competition `ه ل ك:B012/m01`; dense crowding `ل ب د:B002/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The prepared food heap becomes the center of a social pressure field. Appetite draws bodies inward, and abundance can paradoxically produce crowding and rivalry.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material life moves between accumulation, livelihood, feeding, hunger, and the loss of means.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Provision includes wages, hospitality revenue, food heaps, relentless demand, animal appetite, and the idiom of possessing neither hair nor felt.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Poverty, Dust, and Dependence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Loss of means lowers a person toward the ground and forces dependence on others.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: poverty figured as clinging to dust `ت ر ب:B002/m01`; destitution and abasement `س ك ن:B006/m01`; petitioner seeking a sponsor `ه ل ك:B004/m01`; having neither little nor much `ل ب د:B007/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 90:16 `مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ` (س ك ن, ت ر ب); 90:6 `أَهْلَكْتُ`, `لُّبَدًا` (ه ل ك, ل ب د)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Poverty is embodied as lowered posture, bare ground, and absent property. Dependence follows because the destitute person must seek the sustaining relation no longer supplied by possessions.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Vulnerable persons and difficult actions are sustained through reciprocal instruction, self-command, compassion, and protective presence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Care appears as a companion who removes fear, a guarantor who stays, a warning against relapse, and a guard who preserves another through watchfulness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reciprocal Counsel
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Members of a community repeatedly direct one another toward conduct they must sustain together.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: reciprocal injunction `و ص ي:B003/m01`; message relay `ل س ن:B008/m01`; negotiated discussion `ق و ل:B009/m01`; continuing companionship `ص ح ب:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Counsel is a circulating social process. Advice is voiced, relayed, considered with others, and maintained by companions who remain present to one another.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Vulnerable persons and difficult actions are sustained through reciprocal instruction, self-command, compassion, and protective presence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Care appears as a companion who removes fear, a guarantor who stays, a warning against relapse, and a guard who preserves another through watchfulness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mercy and Protective Care
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Compassion recognizes another's vulnerability and acts to preserve that person.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tenderness and beneficent mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`; sincere concern for a matter or person `ق و ل:B015/m01`; protective accompaniment `ص ح ب:B002/m01`; guarding and preservation `ر ق ب:B002/m01`; trusted security `ء م ن:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Mercy becomes concrete through sincere concern, presence, and guarding. Feeling for another leads to accompaniment, and accompaniment creates the security in which the vulnerable person can remain safe.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Vulnerable persons and difficult actions are sustained through reciprocal instruction, self-command, compassion, and protective presence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Care appears as a companion who removes fear, a guarantor who stays, a warning against relapse, and a guard who preserves another through watchfulness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Exertion, Sweat, and Exhaustion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A worker or traveler undertakes a severe task, sweats under effort or fear, and expends strength until exhaustion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hardship and sustained struggle `ك ب د:B002/m01`; sweat from labor, distress, or fear `ن ج د:B006/m01`; self-expenditure to exhaustion `ه ل ك:B009/m01`; road peril few will undertake `ق ح م:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Endurance is legible through bodily cost. Difficulty demands continued effort, sweat registers that effort, and exhaustion marks the point at which the task or road has consumed the traveler's available strength.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Commitment is expressed through assent, sworn speech, expiation, responsive prayer, and offerings brought near.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Ritual commitment reaches oath-release by a token act, "amen" as an answering formula, camouflaged sin erased by covering, and the offering's arrival at its lawful place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Assent, Doctrine, and Denial
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A proposition is inwardly assented to as truth or rejected despite its signs.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: settled assent `ء م ن:B002/m01`; denial and concealment of truth `ك ف ر:B003/m01`; attributing unbelief to another `ك ف ر:B006/m01`; doctrinal position `ق و ل:B013/m01`; visible sign `ء ي ي:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 90:17 `ءَامَنُوا` (ء م ن); 90:19 `كَفَرُوا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا` (ك ف ر, ء ي ي); 90:6 `يَقُولُ` (ق و ل)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Belief and denial are opposing responses to a meaningful sign. Doctrine gives the response an articulated form, assent or rejection locates it in the heart, and accusation assigns that rejected status to another person.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Commitment is expressed through assent, sworn speech, expiation, responsive prayer, and offerings brought near.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Ritual commitment reaches oath-release by a token act, "amen" as an answering formula, camouflaged sin erased by covering, and the offering's arrival at its lawful place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Ingratitude and Disavowal
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A benefit or affiliation is first received, then denied, repudiated, or treated as though it carried no claim.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: covering a benefit with ingratitude `ك ف ر:B004/m01`; disavowing an affiliation `ك ف ر:B005/m01`; destruction through misuse `ه ل ك:B001/m01`; public claim of expenditure `ق و ل:B007/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 90:19 `كَفَرُوا` (ك ف ر); 90:6 `أَهْلَكْتُ`, `يَقُولُ` (ه ل ك, ق و ل)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Disavowal breaks the expected relation between benefit and acknowledgment. The act may consume what was given while speech attempts to control how that consumption is publicly understood.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Action depends on counting, delimiting, possessing power, enduring constraint, and choosing after reflection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Measure also governs astronomical calculation, medium quality, coordinated horse footfall, adequacy, and expansive quantification under negation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Planning, Opinion, and Deliberation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person moves from uncertain supposition through gathered experience and comparison toward a formed intention.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: uncertain supposition `ح س ب:B002/m01`; saying construed as supposition `ق و ل:B011/m01`; experience acquired through time `ن ج د:B010/m01`; reflective planning `ق د ر:B005/m01`; divided attention among alternatives `ق س م:B006/m01`; reasoned opinion `ر ء ي:B002/m01`; practical oversight `ح س ب:B006/m01`; inner unspoken thought `ق و ل:B012/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Deliberation moves from uncertainty toward commitment. Experience, perception, and inner speech supply possible courses, divided attention compares them, and planning converts judgment into a prepared intention.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Action depends on counting, delimiting, possessing power, enduring constraint, and choosing after reflection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Measure also governs astronomical calculation, medium quality, coordinated horse footfall, adequacy, and expansive quantification under negation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Sufficiency and Universal Scope
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A statement tests whether something is enough or whether any possible person falls within its scope.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: adequacy and sufficiency `ح س ب:B003/m01`; universal person under negation `ء ح د:B002/m01`; numerous instances `ء ي ي:B007/m01`; signification `ق و ل:B014/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Sufficiency and universality set opposite boundaries: one asks whether the available amount reaches a threshold, while the other expands reference until no eligible person remains outside it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Conflict exposes agents to danger, organized violence, hostility, restraint, and answering punishment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The conflict field includes sword-and-stick duels, blackened livers as enmity, ceasefire, forced oaths, retaliation, and protected asylum.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Perilous Incursion and Exposure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person enters a danger whose terrain and consequences may overwhelm the entrant.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rash entry into danger `ق ح م:B001/m01`; great road peril `ق ح م:B002/m01`; casting oneself into destruction `ه ل ك:B002/m01`; deadly waste or chasm `ه ل ك:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Incursion crosses the boundary between deliberation and exposure. Once entered, the dangerous route or chasm can no longer be treated as a distant possibility.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Conflict exposes agents to danger, organized violence, hostility, restraint, and answering punishment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The conflict field includes sword-and-stick duels, blackened livers as enmity, ceasefire, forced oaths, retaliation, and protected asylum.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Sword, Stick, and Close Combat
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Opponents close distance and strike with swords, sticks, or a club-like implement.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water is found, carried, leaked, surfaced, filtered, and retained through a set of natural and crafted containers.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Fibers and skins are prepared, layered, worn, cased, or arranged to furnish bodies and dwellings.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: small cushion `ح س ب:B008/m01`; furnishing a house with textiles `ن ج د:B008/m01`; food mat or broad wafer `ص ب ر:B011/m01`; felt floor covering `ل ب د:B001/m03`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Furnishing converts prepared textile into an inhabited interior. Floor layer, cushion, hanging, and food mat organize rest, privacy, and eating within the home.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Celestial and atmospheric phenomena make direction, time, heat, water, and exposure visible.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sky includes a road beacon, lunar mansion, round star cluster, noon heat, persistent rain, stacked white cloud, rainless cloud, winter cold, and drought-driven migration.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Drought, Migration, and Winter Cold
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Failed rain and severe temperature expose people and animals, forcing movement toward relief.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rainless land or year `ه ل ك:B005/m01`; drought driving nomads to settled land `ق ح م:B003/m01`; severe winter cold `ص ب ر:B007/m01`; famine hunger `س غ ب:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Climate becomes social pressure. Drought removes pasture and food, cold increases exposure, and migration carries affected people from open land toward settled provision.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Events are situated in spans, awaited, repeated, succeeded, and known by what remains after them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Temporal order reaches Sunday, waiting in place, repeated prayer or pasture, alternating successors, pot residue, lingering illness, and a bad overnight state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Ending, Aftereffect, and Remaining Trace
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An action reaches its end and leaves a result, residue, illness, or condition behind.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ending and consequence `ع ق ب:B006/m01`; residue and aftereffect `ع ق ب:B011/m01`; destruction or disappearance `ه ل ك:B001/m01`; bad resulting state `ك و ن:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Outcome is read through what remains after the initiating act is over. Residue, illness, bad state, or disappearance gives consequence a concrete temporal signature.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Persons and things are distinguished as one, any, solitary, present, or self-identical.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Identity reaches unique pearls and poems, an image in the pupil, the essence of an object, a confidant as "one's own person," and universal reference under negation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Anyone Under Negation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Negation expands from one possible person to every person who could occupy the role.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: universal person in negative scope `ء ح د:B002/m01`; no human present `ء ن س:B001/m02`; no present eye or household member `ع ي ن:B017/m02`; exhaustive idiom "in every case" `ه ل ك:B008/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The grammatical singular becomes semantically exhaustive. By denying even one eligible witness, the expression denies the entire class.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Orientation assigns sides, routes, regions, and moral or auspicious value.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Direction reaches Yemen and Syria, Ghassan affiliation, vanguard and heel, burial on the right side, blessing, ill omen, and regional rulership.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Yemen, Syria, and Ghassan Affiliation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person or group is identified by regional direction, country, or tribal affiliation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Yemen and affiliation to it `ي م ن:B005/m01`; Syria and movement toward it `ش ء م:B002/m01`; Ghassan clan name `ص ب ر:B016/m01`; Himyarite chief or ruler `ق و ل:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Direction becomes social identity when regions supply names for people, clans, and offices. Yemen, Syria, Ghassan, and the Himyarite title locate affiliation within a geographic field.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Communities distinguish leaders, administrators, honored lineages, and valued persons or property.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Standing includes a steadfast chief, royal intimates, a Himyarite title, inherited honor, full siblings, municipal supervision, best-quality goods, and principal capital.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Chief, Courtier, and Royal Intimate
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A ruler or chief exercises standing through trusted people admitted near the seat of authority.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: steadfast chief `ح ل ل:B012/m01`; Himyarite chief or ruler `ق و ل:B004/m01`; favored courtier `ق ر ب:B004/m01`; crowned ruler `ك ف ر:B015/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rank is organized by controlled nearness. The chief occupies the center, courtiers gain privileged access, and title or crown renders the hierarchy publicly visible.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Communities distinguish leaders, administrators, honored lineages, and valued persons or property.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Standing includes a steadfast chief, royal intimates, a Himyarite title, inherited honor, full siblings, municipal supervision, best-quality goods, and principal capital.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Administration, Supervision, and Objection
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An official inspects conduct, manages public affairs, and answers challenges to a judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: practical administration and moral oversight `ح س ب:B006/m01`; authoritative ruling `ق و ل:B010/m01`; reconsideration and objection `ع ق ب:B008/m01`; watching officer `ر ق ب:B002/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Governance is a cycle of inspection, decision, and reconsideration. Supervision gathers the matter, ruling acts on it, and objection tests whether the decision will stand.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Communities distinguish leaders, administrators, honored lineages, and valued persons or property.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Standing includes a steadfast chief, royal intimates, a Himyarite title, inherited honor, full siblings, municipal supervision, best-quality goods, and principal capital.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Goods or persons are ranked as choice, principal, or intermediate in quality.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: best or choice item `ع ي ن:B014/m01`; choice property `ر ق ب:B012/m01`; medium quality and price `ق ر ب:B016/m02`; accumulated property `م و ل:B001/m01`; social rank or standing `ك و ن:B002/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Valuation separates the best item from ordinary property, distinguishes the principal asset from an approximate middle quality, and extends assessed worth into public standing.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Movement is controlled through pace, support, equipment, relocation, and the body's relation to the ground.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Motion includes a horse's coordinated footfall, muzzle-prompted run, supported swaying, coquettish gait, camel travel for knowledge, dislodging an encampment, and persistent adhesion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Supported Sway and Composed Bearing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A weak or stylized walker sways, leans on companions, and may recover a calm bearing.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: supported swaying walk `ه د ي:B008/m01`; broken or coquettish sway `ه ل ك:B003/m01`; calm, unhurried bearing `ه د ي:B010/m01`; companion support `ص ح ب:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Gait reveals both condition and social support. Sway may signal weakness or display; leaning companions stabilize it, and composed bearing restores directional control.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Movement is controlled through pace, support, equipment, relocation, and the body's relation to the ground.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person, herd, or object is moved from a place, while another remains attached and refuses displacement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dislodging people or camels `ح ل ل:B011/m01`; separation from attachment `ف ك ك:B003/m01`; continued persistence `ف ك ك:B003/m02`; staying and clinging `ل ب د:B003/m01`; settled residence `ب ل د:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Relocation is understood against resistance to movement. Dislodging breaks place-attachment, while clinging and residence preserve it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Compliance, Hesitation, and Loss of Agency
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Agency can be yielded willingly, weakened by dullness, suspended by confusion, or withdrawn through skittish avoidance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel reaches trained animals, bowed posture, circling bewilderment, delayed charity, loose judgment, chastity figured as skittishness, and heavy weak movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Bewilderment and Abased Submission
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Distress removes orientation, causing a person to circle, lower the body, and submit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: confusion with hand to chest `ب ل د:B005/m01`; circling in the wilderness `ه ل ك:B010/m01`; poverty and abasement `س ك ن:B006/m01`; submissive state `ك و ن:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Loss of direction becomes loss of agency. Circling cannot produce progress, distress lowers posture, and submission replaces chosen movement.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı sesle ortaya çıkarılan söz ve harflerden kurulu sözlü ifade olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve aynı çekirdeği taşıyor; dil organı, hükümdar unvanı ve mecazi yan kullanımlar bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal çıplak söz söyleme ve söylenmiş söz çekirdeğidir; organ, unvan, söylenti ve mecazlar ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam bare olduğu için tanım çıplak söyleme ve sözlü ifade anlamıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşünceyi veya sözü sesli biçimde dışa vurma ve böyle dışa vurulmuş harfli sözlü ifade anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
Söylenen şey tek söz, cümle, şiir veya konuşma ölçeğinde olabilir.
Ad biçimleri aynı söylenmiş söz alanında toplanır.

Nitelik özellikle insan için kullanılır ve tek bir söyleme olayını göstermez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir eski bölgesel yönetici unvanını, çoğullarını, kadın biçimini ve sözü geçerli kişi açıklamasını birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve, sıradan söz anlamı değil unvan ve otorite anlamı olduğunu doğru sınırlar.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol çan, gök gürültüsü ve bulut gibi kaynaklardan gelen çınlama ve gürleme seslerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir nesnenin hareketi sırasında ortaya çıkan işitilebilir sesi içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolun çekirdeği fiziksel kararsızlık ve sallanmadır, ses ikincildir; komşu kolda ses ve çınlama daha bağımsız bir anlam alanı oluşturur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol nesnenin oynatılması, yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insanda korku veya öfke yüzünden ortaya çıkan titremeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da gözle görülen düzensiz bir sarsılma veya titreme görünümü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda nesne ve fiziksel kararsızlık kurucudur; komşu kolda insan bedeni ile korku veya öfke nedeni kurucudur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel sallama, hareketten doğan ses ve aynı kökteki duygusal titreme karşılaştırmaları fiziksel hareket çekirdeğinin sınırını en açık biçimde gösterir.

root_profile.summary: Kök, azlık; bir şeyin tepesi veya başı; büyük bir kap; yük taşıma, yükselme ve yola koyulma; korku ya da öfkeden titreme; nesnenin oynayıp yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesi olmak üzere altı ayrı anlam kolunda düzenlenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin kaybolma, bozulma, ölme veya bütünüyle ortadan kalkma sonucuna varmasını ve geçişli kullanımda başkasının bu sonuca sürüklenmesini açıkça destekler. Korku, yoksulluk ve azap adlandırmaları ile yatağın üzerine düşme kullanımı çekirdek anlamdan ayrı, bağlama bağlı uzantılar olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği gerçekleşmiş yok oluş veya işlev kaybıdır; tehlikeye atılma, yer adı, açgözlülük ve özel kalıplar bu çekirdeğe katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimlerdeki yok olma ve yok etme çekirdeği ile sahibinin elinden çıkma, yiyeceğin bozulması ve yatağa düşme gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kaybolarak, bozularak, ölerek veya bütünüyle ortadan kalkarak varlığını ya da işlevini yitirmesi; geçişli kullanımda bir başkasının bu sonuca sürüklenmesidir. Korku, yoksulluk ve ağır eziyet için söylenmesi ile yatağın üzerine düşme kullanımı bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı uzantılarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey kaybolma, bozulma, ölüm veya ortadan kalkma sonucunda varlığını ya da işlevini yitirir.
Geçişli kullanımda bir kişi veya güç başka bir şeyi yok oluş ya da ağır bozulma sonucuna sürükler.
Korku, yoksulluk ve ağır eziyet de yol açtıkları yıkım bakımından bu adla anılabilir.
Belirli bir yatak ifadesinde anlam, kişinin yatağın üzerine düşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, varlığın veya işlevin kayıp, bozulma, ölüm ve yoklukla sona ermesidir. Geçişli kullanım bu sonucu başkasına yöneltir; ağır sıkıntı adlandırmaları ve yatağa düşme örneği ise çekirdeğin özel bağlamlardaki uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Varlığın ya da işlevin kayıp, bozulma, ölüm veya ortadan kalkmayla sona erdiği çekirdek durum ile bunun başkasına yaptırıldığı geçişli kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem yok oluş sonucunu hem de bir başkasını bu sonuca sürükleme yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin, malın veya düzenin ağır bozulma ve yok oluşa uğradığı bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ağır bozulma ve yok oluş sonucunu güçlü biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Sahibinin elinden çıkma gibi daha tarafsız kayıp kullanımlarını ve geçişli yönü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız kişinin yatak veya döşek üzerine düştüğünü bildiren özel kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Özel kullanımın düşme hareketini ve hedef yüzeyi eksiksiz korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yok oluş, kayıp, bozulma veya ölüm

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kaybolma, bozulma, ölüm ve yokluk gibi birden çok yok oluş biçimini ve özel bağlam uzantılarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yok oluşa düşmenin yanında başkasını oraya düşürme ve başkası için yok edici olma özelliğini daha doğrudan öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir varlığın yok oluşa uğramasını ve bu sonucun başkasına yöneltilebilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yok oluşa düşme ve düşürme ekseninde daha sıkıdır; odak dal ise kayıp, bozulma, ölüm ve bütünüyle ortadan kalkma türlerini daha geniş biçimde bir araya getirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal sahibinin elinden çıkma ve yiyeceğin bozulması gibi özel gerçekleşmeleri de barındırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sapma, bela ve yıkım yeri gibi kendine özgü değerlendirme ve bağlamları da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da kişi veya şeyin bozulması, geçersizleşmesi ve yok olması ortak alandır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekler güçlü biçimde örtüşse de özel kullanımlar ve değerlendirme alanları aynı değildir; bu yüzden tam eş anlamlılık kurulamaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; yayımlanan iki komşu çekirdek sınırı doğrudan aydınlatır. Kalanlar yalnız tek bir sonuç türünü, aynı senaryodaki başka bir aşamayı veya bu kökün ayrı dallarını temsil eder.
branches.what_is_ar: هلاك الشيء وذهابه وفساده وموته وفناؤه وإهلاكه والعذاب الداخل في الهلاك
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس خصوص رمي النفس في التهلكة ولا المهواة الموضعية ولا الجذب ولا الشرَه
branches.source_phrase_ar: يدل على كسر وسقوط (maqayis)؛ الهلك الهلاك (ayn;tahdhib)؛ هلك الشيء يهلك هلاكا وهلوكا (sihah)؛ الهلاك على أوجه افتقاد الشيء واستحالة وفساد والموت وبطلان الشيء وعدمه (mufradat)؛ يقال للعذاب والخوف والفقر الهلاك (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem kişinin kendisini sonu yok oluş olan tehlikeye atmasını hem de sonu böyle bir yok oluşa varan şeyi bildirir. Kuş örneği çekirdeği açıklayan özel bir olaydır; gerçekleşmiş ölüm veya uçurumun kendisi dalın tanımı değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Sınır, gerçekleşmiş yok oluşta değil, kişinin kendini ona götüren tehlikeye atmasında ve bu sonucu doğuracak tehlikede kurulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tehlikeli sonucu adlandıran biçimler ile korkan kuşun kendini tehlikeye atmasını bildiren özel ifade ayrılır; anlam yalın yok olma fiiline genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin kendisini ölüm veya ağır yok oluşla sonuçlanabilecek bir tehlikeye atması ve bu sonuca götüren tehlikenin kendisidir. Korkudan kendini tehlikeli bir yere atan kuş, eylemin özel örneğidir.

facets.statement: Kişi kendisini sonu ölüm veya ağır yok oluş olabilecek bir tehlikenin içine atar.
Sonunda yok oluş bulunan şey veya durum, bu sonucu doğuracak tehlike olarak adlandırılır.
Yırtıcıdan korkan bir kuşun kendisini tehlikeli yerlere atması bu eyleme örnek verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin kendisini yok oluş ihtimali taşıyan bir duruma atması ile sonu yok oluşa varacak tehlikeyi aynı anlam alanında birleştirir. Korkan kuş örneği, korunma çabasının bizzat başka bir tehlikeye girişe dönüşebildiğini gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: kendini ölümcül tehlikeye atma ve buna götüren tehlike
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem kişinin kendi eylemini hem de eylemin sonunda yok oluş doğurabilecek tehlikeli durum veya şeyi birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Eyleyen kişinin kendini tehlikeye atmasını, tehlikenin ölümcül sonucunu ve sonuç doğuran şeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin ağır sonucu bile bile ya da korkuyla göze aldığı tehlikeli girişimler için doğal bir anlatımdır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin kendi eylemiyle ciddi tehlikeye girmesini güçlü biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Tehlikeli şeyin kendisini adlandıran sonuç odaklı yönü dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.collision: Gerçek ateş sanılmaması için bağlam gerektirebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kişinin kendisini yok oluşa götürebilecek tehlikeye atma eylemini ve tehlikeli nedeni anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, tehlikeden önceki girişe değil, kayıp, bozulma, ölüm veya yok oluş sonucunun gerçekleşmesine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da ölüm veya ağır yok oluş ihtimalinin bulunduğu aynı sonuç zincirinde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal riskli giriş ve ona yol açan tehlikedir; komşu dal ise bu zincirin gerçekleşmiş yok oluş sonucudur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yayımlanan karşılaştırma eylemi gerçekleşmiş yok oluş sonucundan ayırır. Öteki adaylar zorunluluk, yaklaşan ölüm, umursamaz zarar verme, genel tehlike veya kökün uzak dallarıyla sınırlıdır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مطلق الهلاك بعد وقوعه ولا المهواة بوصفها موضعا

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi salınarak ve kırıtılarak yürüme hareketini doğrular, fakat kadın için kullanılan ağır ahlaki niteleme bu hareketin zorunlu anlamı değil, eski ve küçültücü bir değerlendirme uzantısıdır. Tanım hareket çekirdeğini öncelemeli, değer yargısını ayrı bir kullanım olarak göstermelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kadın yürüyüşündeki salınma ve kırıtmayı temel alır; ahlaki yargı tarihsel bir niteleme olarak ayrılır ve genel yok oluş anlamı dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yürüyüşü bildiren ifade hareketi anlatır; kadın için kullanılan ad ise hareketle ilişkilendirilmiş eski bir küçültücü nitelemedir ve ikisi tek yargıda eritilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kadının yürürken veya cilveli davranırken bedenini salındırıp kırıtmasıdır. Bu harekete bağlanan kadın adı, bazı eski kullanımlarda ayrıca ağır ve küçültücü bir ahlak yargısı taşır.

facets.statement: Kadın yürürken veya cilveli davranırken bedenini salındırır ve kırıtılmış hareketler yapar.
Hareket biçiminden türeyen kadın nitelemesi eski kullanımda küçültücü bir ahlak yargısına dönüşebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak hareket görüntüsü, yürürken salınan ve kırıtılan bedendir. Bazı açıklamalar bu görüntüyü doğrudan yürüyüş ve cilveyle verirken bazıları kadın için ağır bir ahlaki nitelemeye dönüştürür; ikinci yön çekirdeğin değerlendirme uzantısıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kadına bağlanan hareket çekirdeğini, yani yürüyüş veya cilve sırasında bedenin salınmasını ve kırıtılmasını doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Hareketin salınma, kırıtma ve yürüyüş bağlamlarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yürüyüşün cilveli ve bedensel salınımlı oluşunun öne çıktığı cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yürüyüşteki cilveli salınma ve kırıtma hareketini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız eski ve küçültücü kadın adlandırmasının ahlaki yargısını açıklamak gerektiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Eski kullanımın küçültücü ahlak yargısını açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Nitelemenin dayandığı salınma ve kırıtma hareketini tek başına göstermez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kırıtarak yürüyen; eski kullanımda ahlaksız diye nitelenen kadın

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kadın yürüyüşündeki salınmayı ve bundan doğan küçültücü kadın adını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, süslenip kıvrılmanın yanında kişinin bir ihtiyacı için yumuşak davranıp yalvarmasını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kadın hareketindeki cilve, kıvrılma ve kırıtma görünümünde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak yürüyüş ve ona bağlanan kadın nitelemesiyle sınırlıdır; komşu ise istekte bulunurken takınılan yumuşak ve yalvaran davranışa da uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda kadın, cilve ve kırıtma bileşenleri ile değerlendirme uzantısı bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kadınla sınırlı değildir ve atın ya da erkeğin genel olarak sallanarak veya gösterişli yürümesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın gözlenebilir ortak alanı yürüyüş sırasında bedenin yana doğru salınmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu genel bir yürüme biçimidir; odak ise kadın yürüyüşündeki cilveli kırıtmayı ve buna bağlanan özel nitelemeyi taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yürüyüşü ve eski küçültücü kadın adlandırmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hareketi özellikle kadının eşine karşı nazlanıp kırıtmasıyla sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da kadının cilveli biçimde kırıtması ortak harekettir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşuda eşe yönelme şarttır; odakta böyle bir muhatap şartı yoktur ve yürüyüş başlı başına yeterlidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; seçilen üçü hareket çekirdeğini genel salınma, eşe yönelen naz ve daha geniş kırıtma davranışından ayırır. Kalanlar beden görünümü, cinsel temas, gerinme veya kökün ilgisiz dallarıdır.
